messages:
Nora Lee: Ok team — launch week is two weeks out. Plan is: webinar on Wed, product launch on Thu. Need paid search ramp, retargeting cadence, creative refresh schedule, and inbound routing ✅
Miguel Santos: +1. I can own search pacing and bids. proposing a 4-step bid ramp Mon-Wed to hit peak Wed morning then pull back Thu evening. budget daily caps to avoid overspend.
Priya Patel: I'll lock landing page UTMs + trackable CTAs. Make sure webinar reg form has campaign param: utm_campaign=launch_week_v1
Samir Ahmed: For retargeting, let's do 3 windows: 0-3d high freq, 4-10d medium, 11-30d low. Frequency caps: 4/day -> 2/day -> 1/day. Keep creatives separate per window.
Elaine Cho: Creative plan: we need 3 headline variants, 2 hero images, 1 short demo video. I'll prep a creative matrix and filename convention: LW23_VariantA_Image1.mp4 etc. Rotate creative at 48h and refresh the hero on Wed morning.
Miguel Santos: Bid ramp snippet I'm thinking: Mon 30% baseline, Tue 60%, Wed 110% (webinar peak 8-11am PT), Thu 40% (post-launch). Set rule: if CPA > 2x baseline then pause non-brand bids.
Nora Lee: Good — can you add a rule to increase retarget bid by +15% for users who opened webinar invite email within 48h?
Miguel Santos: on it. I'll add a rule in ad manager.
Priya Patel: Routing: inbound leads from webinar registrants -> SFDC campaign Launch2024_Webinar. Set lead score = engaged if attended or watched >50%. Also auto-assign to AE queue "launch-wave".
Samir Ahmed: Small ask: add a dedicated retargeting segment for people who visited pricing but didn't register. Exclude attendees.
Elaine Cho: Creative refresh timing check — I'm scheduling first refresh Tue 9am PT, second Wed 7am PT (pre-webinar), last refresh Thu 10am PT (post-launch).
Nora Lee: Budget question — can we hold a 10% buffer for on-the-fly bids on high-performing geos?
Miguel Santos: yes, carve out buffer. I'll set a separate geo-burst budget and only turn on after 6am Wed if ROAS > target.
AdOps Bot: Campaigns created: launch_search_nonbrand, launch_search_brand, launch_retarget_0_3d, launch_retarget_4_10d, launch_retarget_11_30d. IDs: 87921, 87922, 87923, 87924, 87925
Priya Patel: thanks bot. Quick note: GA4 events wired for webinar_reg and webinar_attend?
Elaine Cho: yes, QA passed on staging.
Samir Ahmed: Also add an exclusion for users who converted via the demo trial form in the last 30 days.
Nora Lee: Perfect. Can everyone drop a single-line update by EOD Friday? I'll compile a launch-week playbook doc then. :rocket:
Miguel Santos: will do.
Priya Patel: done.
Elaine Cho: working on assets now.
Samir Ahmed: will finish retarget segments and rules.
AdOps Bot: Reminder scheduled: Launch-week prep sync tomorrow 10:00 AM PT — calendar invite sent to channel.
